scope: Approved static design semantic binding only; not implementation/runtime/effective ACL proof

attack_coverage.attack: field reachable without approved producer step
attack_coverage.evidence: All146 field-map rows have an approved producer step; sensitive paths reference exact S04/S05 inputs and membrane contract.

attack_coverage.attack: predicate not bound to exact callable
attack_coverage.evidence: Six gap predicates map to exact S07/S08 IDs and original expressions; all26 retain fixed evaluator family.
Approved step/callable records compare byte-for-value JSON equality; terminal principal fields and supporting acquisition chains are explicit.
No approved principal value changed; pure compartment has no session/DB capability; source membrane narrow authority is explicit.

attack_coverage.attack: owner authority leaking into caller authority
attack_coverage.evidence: Former relation_authority_edge is now observed_relation_acl_constructor with false authorization flag; capability contract supplies producer authority.
G2 excludes query text and arbitrary SQL APIs; enforced acquisition custody/transport proof remains mandatory physical acceptance, not claimed done.
All source relation/field sets closed and exact; no caller identifier parameter.
Caller object selection is false; complete fixed metadata scope is inherited, not expanded by binding.
Producer forbids SD; symbolic SD edge remains conditional authority constructor rather than executed grant or transition.
INHERIT/SET/ADMIN/owner constructors preserved separately; no membership added to approved producer.
Approved operations disallow writes; source body digests do not execute body/default/trigger/policy callbacks.
Sensitive raw config/body handled only within source membrane; only approved assertions/digests leave; secret stores never selected.
Reader descriptor confined to approved acquisition; pure S06/S07/S08 receive bounded frames, not credentials; bridge remains separate.
No raw config/body release in any predicate truth branch; source authorization precedes read and transform precedes membrane output.
S04 config sanitizer and S05 stored-byte digest are source operations; no raw transport/log/error output permitted.
Pure steps have no source relations, session or credential; unknown callable/source request rejected.

attack_coverage.attack: output schema not matching transform result
attack_coverage.evidence: Canonical field expressions plus approved codec are bound per field; config FIELD expression is explicitly overridden by CONFIG_ASSERTIONS_V2.

attack_coverage.attack: source relation aliases bypassing approved universe
attack_coverage.evidence: Exact fully qualified source names and fixed row scopes used; no caller alias/type/operator selection.

attack_coverage.attack: duplicate graph edge with conflicting semantics
attack_coverage.evidence: All390 IDs unique; modified hashes recompute; split aggregate has eight different approved step contracts; no old/new double disposition.
G2 defines closed abstract effect classes and forbids unclassified implicit callbacks before admission. Zero missing families is static-contract coverage, not assertion of machine callsite expansion.

attack_coverage.attack: future implementation assumption used as current proof
attack_coverage.evidence: Every claim scoped to approved normative contract; source, auth, transport, ACL, build/runtime proof remain future mandatory acceptance.
Source hashes freeze inputs only; semantic chain uses approved normative behavior. Body digest does not prove effect or invocation.
Codec is exact representation input; source authorization derives explicit approved membrane contract, not codec.

attack_coverage.attack: output policy used as callable proof
attack_coverage.evidence: Exact approved step/callable/principal/effect record is preserved. Output description alone does not authorize source access.

resolved_findings.issue: Old relation SELECT/PUBLIC ACL link could be mistaken for actual membrane source authorization
resolved_findings.resolution: Renamed observed_relation_acl_constructor, explicit observed_acl_is_producer_authorization=false, exact source_authorization_contract reference; independent fresh check passed

limitations: This review accepts design binding, not actual executable callable closure, PostgreSQL ACL or transport enforcement.
Actual source implementation and machine explicit/implicit calls must be independently accepted before activation; unknown call cannot be admitted on digest/output assertions.
Potential PUBLIC/ownership/SD constructor edges are observations, not assertions those privileges are absent or producer-authorized.
